text: To the west, you can see a natural light. For the first time in your life, you are looking at the outside world.
source_text: To the west, you can see a natural light. For the first time in your life, you are looking at the outside world.

text: To the west, you can see stars in an open sky. For the first time in your life, you are looking at the outside world.

text: 西边出现了阳光，你这辈子第一次看到了外面的世界。

text: 在西边出现了满天的星斗，你今生第一次见到了外面的世界。
